title: Summarize a JSON test report
description: Count test outcomes, list failed names, and total recorded durations from a small JSON report.
program: ASSERT(EVERY(input.tests, (test) -> test.name != null), "Every test needs a name")
ASSERT(EVERY(input.tests, (test) -> test.duration_ms != null), "Every test needs duration_ms")
ASSERT(EVERY(input.tests, (test) -> test.status == "passed" || test.status == "failed" || test.status == "skipped"), "Unknown test status")

exercise.instruction: Change checkout status from failed to passed, then run again.

recipe.problem: Turn a flat JSON test report into a build summary with counts, recorded duration, and names to investigate.
prerequisites: tests is a required array. Each test needs a name, status passed/failed/skipped, and a nonnegative integer duration_ms.
This input is plain JSON, not a JUnit XML document.
explanation: The assertions prevent missing durations from silently becoming zero and reject unknown outcomes.
The three filters classify each record. failed_tests keeps the original order of failed names.
The status is failing if any test failed, no-runs if none passed or failed, and passing otherwise.
duration_ms sums all recorded durations; an empty report has a zero sum.
limits: Summed durations are recorded test time, not wall-clock build duration when tests run in parallel.
Retries and duplicate names are counted as separate records. The recipe does not parse test-runner-specific formats.
Keep durations and totals within the cross-runtime safe integer range.
